verses.text: <pb/><t>Zunubi yakan yi magana da mugun daga can gindin zuciyarsa,</t> <t>Yakan ƙi Allah, ba ya jin tsoronsa.</t>
<t>Domin yana ganin kansa shi wani abu ne,</t> <t>A tsammaninsa Allah ba zai tona asirinsa ba,</t> <t>Ya hukunta zunubinsa.</t>
<t>Maganarsa mugunta ce cike da ƙarairayi,</t> <t>Ba shi da sauran isasshiyar hikima da zai aikata nagarta.</t>
<t>Yana ƙulla mugunta lokacin da yake kwance a gadonsa,</t> <t>Halinsa ba shi da kyau,</t> <t>Ba ya ƙin abin da yake mugu. <pb/></t>
<t>Madawwamiyar ƙaunarka, ya Ubangiji,</t> <t>Ta kai har sammai,</t> <t>Amincinka ya kai sararin sammai.</t>
<t>Adalcinka kafaffe ne,</t> <t>Kamar manyan duwatsu.</t> <t>Hukuntanka kamar teku mai zurfi suke.</t> <t>Ya Ubangiji, kai kake lura da mutane da dabbobi. <pb/></t>
<t>Ina misalin darajar madawwamiyar ƙaunarka, ya Ubangiji!</t> <t>Mutane sukan sami mafaka a ƙarƙashin fikafikanka.</t>
<t>Sukan yi biki da yalwataccen abincin da yake Haikalinka,</t> <t>Kakan shayar da su daga koginka na alheri.</t>
<t>Kai ne mafarin dukan rai,</t> <t>Saboda haskenka ne kuma, muke ganin haske, <pb/></t>
<t>Ka yi ta ƙaunar waɗanda suka san ka,</t> <t>Ka yi wa adalai alheri.</t>
<t>Kada ka bar masu girmankai su fāɗa mini,</t> <t>Kada ka bar mugaye su kore ni.</t>
<t>Dubi inda mugaye suka fāɗi!</t> <t>Can suka kwanta, ba su iya tashi.</t>
